office_does: Okanogan County District Court hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, limited-value civil cases, small claims and protection orders; its two judges are elected countywide for four years.
race_blurb: Presiding Judge Charles Short, on the bench since 2013 and dean of the Washington State Judicial College, is endorsed by both county party central committees; felony deputy prosecutor John Andrew Bangerter runs on a 'fresh perspective', efficiency and holding convicted offenders accountable.

candidates.summary: Okanogan County District Court judge since 2013 and its presiding judge; dean of the Washington State Judicial College.
highlights: District Court judge since 2013; retained in 2014, 2018 and 2022 [S1][S4]
Dean of the Washington State Judicial College and past president of the District and Municipal Court Judges' Association [S1][S2]
2024 David A. Steiner Judicial Leadership Award [S1][S2]
Endorsed by the Okanogan County Democratic and Republican central committees, the Washington Farm Bureau and more than 100 judicial officers [S3]

experience.basis: Thirteen-year incumbent and presiding judge with statewide judicial-education leadership.

candidates.summary: Okanogan County felony deputy prosecutor, formerly a prosecutor in Chelan and Grays Harbor counties and a Microsoft security operations manager, seeking his first judgeship.
highlights: Felony deputy prosecutor in Okanogan County; earlier handled District Court cases [S1][S2]
'It is time for a fresh perspective and a positive change' [S1]
Pledges convicted offenders 'will be held responsible' in 'a fair, firm, and consistent manner' [S1][S3]
Endorsed by Chelan County's prosecuting attorney, a former Chelan District Court judge and victim advocates [S4]

experience.basis: No judicial experience; runs explicitly on 'a fresh perspective and a positive change' against a 13-year incumbent.

safety.basis: Prosecutor formation and endorsers, with accountability language for convicted offenders alongside due process and victim protection.
